intent: Inspect and refactor CorrelationWebFilter without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation correlation middleware (single unit): WebFilter adopting the inbound X-Request-Id header (via CorrelationContext.headerName()) when it is non-blank, at most 128 characters and matches [A-Za-z0-9._-], otherwise generating a random UUID; writes it to the response header and into the Reactor Context under CorrelationContext.contextKey() with contextWrite around chain.filter(exchange). Self-registered with @Component and the highest precedence order (not produced by the wiring unit). No logger, no MDC.
